data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for tokenizing card payments and device sessions via the Openpay BBVA platform.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to integrate with the Openpay BBVA payment gateway. It supports card tokenization and card saving via HTTP on all platforms, as well as native device session ID collection for anti-fraud support on iOS and Android.
use_when: You need to process card payments via Openpay BBVA in a Flutter application.
You require card tokenization or card saving functionality across mobile, web, and desktop platforms.
avoid_when: You are using a payment gateway other than Openpay BBVA.
You need a complete UI component set for checkout rather than direct tokenization logic.
strengths: Supports card tokenization and card saving across iOS, Android, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Includes native anti-fraud device session ID generation for iOS and Android.
Provides structured error handling through custom Openpay exceptions.
weaknesses: Device Session ID is not supported on Web and desktop platforms (returns null).
Requires platform-specific configuration and permissions on Android.
data.setup_notes: Add INTERNET and ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE permissions to AndroidManifest.xml for Android. Initialize OpenpayBBVA with your Merchant ID and Public API Key.
